title: Skill Properties
description: Canonical frontmatter schema for SKILL.md files in this repository. Enforced by SkillsFramework/scripts/validate_skills.py. Portable fields (name, description, license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools) are accepted by API and claude.ai uploads; Claude Code-only fields are warned about; rules are explained in docs/authoring/advanced-skill-development.md.

name.description: 1-64 characters, lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, no leading, trailing or consecutive hyphens. Must equal the folder name. Must not contain the reserved words 'anthropic' or 'claude'. Names of CLI-focused skills end with '-cli' and set metadata.interface to 'cli'.

description.description: Non-empty, at most 1024 characters, third person, states what the skill does and when to use it, includes at least one trigger phrase, no XML tags.

version.description: Independent semantic version for this skill (major.minor.patch).

status.description: Lifecycle stage. Should agree with which directory tier the skill lives in (see README's Source of Truth section).

category.description: Primary catalogue category, e.g. cybersecurity, legal, devops.

risk.description: Impact if the skill's actions go wrong. High-risk skills should set requires_confirmation.

requires_confirmation.description: Whether the skill must pause for explicit user confirmation before destructive, external, or credential-using actions.

permissions.description: Declares what the skill's instructions ask an agent to do, for the threat model in docs/security/threat-model.md.

runtime.description: Agent/model runtimes this skill is written for or has been converted for, e.g. claude, claude-desktop, generic-agents.

allowed-tools.description: Tool patterns required by the skill (experimental upstream feature, format: Tool(pattern:*) Tool(pattern:*)).

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for client-specific properties not covered above.

argument-hint.description: Hint text shown for slash-command-style skill arguments.

user-invocable.description: Whether a user can invoke this skill directly (e.g. via /skill-name).

reviewed.description: Date this skill's content was last reviewed for accuracy (YYYY-MM-DD).

references.description: Paths to reference files this skill depends on, relative to the skill directory.

inputs.description: Named inputs (env vars, parameters) the skill expects.
